title: Sanger Tree of Life HMW DNA Extraction: Manual MagAttract v3
author: Graeme Oatley
materials: For PowerMashed samples (weight less than 25 mg):

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the lysis buffer master mix as required.

steps.title: Sample Preparation and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Transfer 25 mg prepped sample into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube and hold on dry ice to keep frozen.

substeps.instruction: Remove sample from dry ice and add 374 µL of lysis buffer master mix.
Homogenize by gently pipetting 10 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Transfer sample into a 1.5 mL BioMasher II tube and add 374 µL lysis buffer.
Disrupt sample using the Diagnocine PowerMasher II tissue disruptor and BioMasher pestle until no large pieces remain or further disruption is impossible.

steps.title: Lysis and Incubation
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire contents of the BioMasher tube to a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube using a wide-bore tip.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge all sample tubes briefly in a mini centrifuge.
Incubate on the heat block at 25 ºC for 2 hours.
Briefly centrifuge samples in a mini centrifuge to spin down.

steps.title: Lysate Recovery
steps.instruction: Using a wide-bore pipette tip set to 380 µL, transfer lysate to new microcentrifuge tubes, avoiding insoluble material.

steps.title: Bead Binding
steps.instruction: Add 280 µL Buffer MB and 40 µL of Suspension G beads to each sample.

substeps.instruction: Invert the tube 10 to 20 times to suspend beads in the lysate.
Allow 5 minutes for binding.
Briefly centrifuge samples in a mini centrifuge to collect beads at the bottom.

steps.title: Initial Bead Separation
steps.instruction: Place tubes on the magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes (longer for viscous samples) for beads to migrate.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Buffer MW1 Washes
steps.instruction: Perform two rounds of MW1 washes.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from magnetic rack and add 700 µL Buffer MW1 directly to the bead pellet.
Invert the tube 10 to 20 times to suspend beads.
Spin down in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds.
Place on magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes (longer for viscous samples) and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Buffer PE Washes
steps.instruction: Perform two rounds of PE washes.

substeps.instruction: Remove tubes from magnetic rack and add 700 µL Buffer PE directly to the bead pellet.
Invert 10 to 20 times to resuspend beads.
Spin down in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds.
Place on magnetic rack for 2–5 minutes (longer for viscous samples) and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Overnight Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate samples overnight at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Repeat the PE wash process (Step 17/PE wash) for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Final Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash beads with nuclease-free water while tubes remain on the magnetic rack.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 700 µL nuclease-free water onto the side opposite of the beads (do not pipette directly onto the pellet).
Incubate for exactly 1 minute, then slowly aspirate and discard water.
Briefly centrifuge in a mini centrifuge and place back on the magnetic rack.
Use a small micropipette to remove any residual wash buffer.

steps.title: gDNA Elution
steps.instruction: Remove samples from the magnetic rack and add 400 µL of Buffer AE directly to the bead pellet.

substeps.instruction: Mix by gently flicking or using a wide-bore pipette tip to dislodge the pellet.
Following overnight incubation, pipette mix samples slowly 5 times with a wide-bore pipette tip.
Briefly centrifuge in a mini centrifuge and place on a magnetic rack for bead capture.
Using a 200 μL wide-bore pipette tip, carefully transfer the supernatant containing purified gDNA to a fresh microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: 0.45X SPRI Purification
steps.instruction: Perform a 0.45X SPRI purification manually or via KingFisher Apex.

substeps.instruction: Set heat block to 37 °C and label two sets of 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes for each sample.
Incubate the mix on the bench top for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down tubes in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds to collect beads.
Mix beads/DNA thoroughly by pipetting 15 times with a wide-bore pipette tip (do not flick).
Immediately add 180 μL of AMPure PB beads to the 400 μL of DNA.
Vortex AMPure PB beads for 30 seconds.
Spin down tubes in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds to collect beads.

steps.title: SPRI Bead Separation
steps.instruction: Slowly pipette off cleared supernatant and save in the first labelled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, avoiding disturbing the beads.

substeps.instruction: Briefly spin down tubes for 1–2 seconds in a mini centrifuge and place on the magnetic rack.
Allow beads to pellet (may take 5 minutes or more).

steps.title: Ethanol Washes
steps.instruction: Perform two ethanol washes with freshly prepared 80% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Keep tubes in the magnetic bead rack until beads pellet on the side.
Slowly dispense 700–1000 µL of 80% ethanol against the side of the tube opposite the beads.
After 30 seconds, pipette and discard the 80% ethanol.

steps.title: Final Elution and Storage
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Incubate tubes on the heat block at 37 °C for 30 minutes at 350 rpm.
Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 135 µL of EB buffer to the beads.
Gently mix by slowly pipetting 15 times with a wide-bore pipette tip (do not flick).
Check for ethanol droplets; if present, repeat the EB buffer addition/mixing step.
Spin down in a mini centrifuge for 1–2 seconds, return to magnetic rack, and aspirate any remaining ethanol.
Slowly pipette off cleared supernatant and save in the second labelled 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Store the extracted gDNA sample at 4 ºC and proceed to QC.
